name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
label: Quest
description: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A great weight has been lifted from our hearts, friend, but your task is not yet complete. Krastinov's master, Kirtonos, still lives.
Before you may face Kirtonos, however, you must first secure a method in which to summon him.
It is said that Jandice Barov stewards the blood of innocents from Krastinov to Kirtonos.
Find her in the sunken catacombs of Scholomance and strike her down. Bring back any clues that you may find.
